title: Identification of an Individualized Metabolism Prognostic Signature and Related Therapy Regimens in Early Stage Lung Adenocarcinoma.
summary: The paper reports survival stratification across training, testing and independent cohorts, plus treatment-subgroup analyses and cell assays. Observational treatment-subgroup results do not establish that the signature predicts benefit from a specific therapy.
ai_technology: Machine learning constructed a 12-gene-pair metabolism risk index and combined it with clinical variables to stratify early-stage lung-adenocarcinoma prognosis.
organization: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Shanghai Pulmonary Hospital, Tongji University School of Medicine
